sar.narrative: Suspicious Activity Report for CASE-016 involving card SC-03016-K953 and customer SC-03016. The investigation was initiated after the real-time risk model assigned a score of 0.89 to transaction 4012183 ($582.85, domestic) [EV-048bb542]. Analysis revealed the transaction was conducted via a previously unseen device (Samsung SM-G973F) and routed through an anonymous proxy IP located in Argentina [EV-9356b9a0, EV-bc741f9a]. Within a 48-hour window, three card-not-present transactions totaling $1,428.34 were identified, significantly above the card's historical average transaction value of $476.11 [EV-e0dea8e9, EV-702cf05f]. The device fingerprint has been associated with one prior confirmed fraud case, and the customer has a history of one prior fraud case (CC-4324) [EV-79bae323, EV-1fddc06f]. The customer reported no authorization of the disputed transactions and confirmed the physical card remained in their possession [EV-53a52240]. The pattern aligns with six prior closed cases categorized as card_not_present_new_device [EV-4ff33b55]. Based on the convergence of device anomaly, proxy usage, velocity, and customer disavowal, the case was closed with a fraud verdict and an exposure of $1,428.34. The activity exhibits hallmarks of account takeover with synthetic device generation and IP obfuscation. Recommend enhanced device fingerprinting and proxy detection controls for card-not-present channels.
